# Spatial Texture Extraction {#sec-texture}

::: {.chapter-goal}
#### In this chapter
You will add pattern to spectrum: grey level co occurrence matrix features that let a classifier tell a uniform plantation from a structurally complex natural forest that reflects almost identically.
:::
